description: Run your commercetools store: manage products, prices, stock, customers, orders, deliveries and discount codes, and start workflows on new orders, status changes, returns, low stock and abandoned carts.

commercetools_abandoned_cart_trigger.description: Runs for a shopper's cart with items in it that has sat unchanged for the hours you choose without being ordered. Only carts with an email address or customer account, from the last week.

output.customer_id: The customer's id, if they have an account.
output.item_count: How many items are in it.
output.last_changed_at: When the shopper last changed it.
output.product_names: The name of each product in it.

parameters.description: How many hours a cart sits unchanged before it counts as abandoned, like 24. Defaults to 24.
parameters.name: hours

commercetools_low_stock_trigger.description: Runs when a SKU's available stock falls to the threshold or less. It runs again for that SKU only after it is restocked and falls again.

output.available_quantity: How many can still be ordered.
output.quantity_on_stock: How many are in stock, reserved ones included.
output.supply_channel_id: The warehouse (supply channel), if it has one.

parameters.description: Run when this many or fewer are available, like 5. Defaults to 5; 0 means out of stock.
parameters.name: threshold

commercetools_new_customer_trigger.description: Runs for each new customer account. Customers who signed up before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.customer_group_id: Their customer group's id, if any.

commercetools_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new commercetools order. Orders placed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.customer_id: The customer's id, if they have an account.
output.item_count: How many items were ordered in all.
output.order: The whole order, with its items and addresses.
output.order_number: The order number, if it has one.
output.payment_state: The payment status, like Paid or Pending.
output.shipment_state: The shipment status, like Ready or Shipped.

commercetools_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs for each new payment recorded in commercetools. Payments made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.payment: The whole payment, with its transactions.
output.payment_service: The payment service, like Stripe or Adyen.
output.status: The payment service's own status code.

commercetools_new_product_trigger.description: Runs for each new product, published or not. Products created before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.has_unpublished_changes: Whether it has changes not yet published.
output.name: Its name, in the project's first language.
output.price: The main variant's first price, like 29.99 EUR.
output.version: Its version; every change adds one.

commercetools_new_quote_request_trigger.description: Runs for each new quote request a B2B buyer sends. Requests sent before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.business_unit_key: The buyer's business unit, if any.
output.item_count: How many items were asked for.
output.state: Submitted, Accepted, Rejected, Closed or Cancelled.
output.total: The requested items' total, like 1200.00 EUR.

commercetools_new_return_trigger.description: Runs for each item added to an order's returns. Returns added before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.comment: The comment given with the return.
output.order_number: The order number, if it has one.
output.return_tracking_id: The return's tracking number, if given.

commercetools_new_review_trigger.description: Runs for each new product review. Reviews written before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.customer_id: The reviewer's customer id, if any.
output.title: The review's title.

commercetools_order_status_changed_trigg.description: Runs when an order's status changes, such as to Confirmed or Complete. A new order doesn't start it for the status it was placed with.

output.customer_id: The customer's id, if they have an account.
output.item_count: How many items were ordered in all.
output.order: The whole order, with its items and addresses.
output.order_number: The order number, if it has one.
output.payment_state: The payment status, like Paid or Pending.
output.shipment_state: The shipment status, like Ready or Shipped.

parameters.description: Only when it changes to this status: Open, Confirmed, Complete, Cancelled. Leave empty for any change.
parameters.name: status

commercetools_payment_status_changed_tri.description: Runs when an order's payment status changes, such as to Paid or Failed. A new order doesn't start it for the status it was placed with.

output.customer_id: The customer's id, if they have an account.
output.item_count: How many items were ordered in all.
output.order: The whole order, with its items and addresses.
output.order_number: The order number, if it has one.
output.payment_state: The payment status, like Paid or Pending.
output.shipment_state: The shipment status, like Ready or Shipped.

parameters.description: Only when it changes to this status: Pending, Paid, BalanceDue, CreditOwed, Failed. Leave empty for any change.
parameters.name: status

commercetools_product_changed_trigger.description: Runs each time a product is created or changed, including when it is published, unpublished or its price changes. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it.

output.has_unpublished_changes: Whether it has changes not yet published.
output.name: Its name, in the project's first language.
output.price: The main variant's first price, like 29.99 EUR.
output.version: Its version; every change adds one.

commercetools_shipment_status_changed_tr.description: Runs when an order's shipment status changes, such as to Shipped or Delivered. A new order doesn't start it for the status it was placed with.

output.customer_id: The customer's id, if they have an account.
output.item_count: How many items were ordered in all.
output.order: The whole order, with its items and addresses.
output.order_number: The order number, if it has one.
output.payment_state: The payment status, like Paid or Pending.
output.shipment_state: The shipment status, like Ready or Shipped.

parameters.description: Only when it changes to this status: Pending, Ready, Shipped, Delivered, Partial, Delayed, Backorder, Canceled. Leave empty for any change.
parameters.name: status
